lastCompletedStory.title: Add the closed, ordered why-not-moving diagnostic rule-set

nextStoryContext: US-003 added a NEW pure module `src/commands/status-diagnostics.ts` exporting `diagnoseWhyNotMoving(report: WhyNotMovingReportInput, signals: WhyNotMovingSignals): WhyNotMovingDiagnostic` -- zero I/O, zero LLM, total over a closed 12-entry enum (`WhyNotMovingConditionId`, exported ordered as `WHY_NOT_MOVING_CONDITIONS`): operator-paused > ship-stalled > plan-escalated > plan-preflight-failed > implement-blocked > post-merge-stalled > sidecar-stalled > gate-awaiting-decision > merge-watch-waiting > orch-pane-busy > delivery-exhausted > none. Each condition maps to exactly ONE fixed message + ONE fixed suggested command (private `WHY_NOT_MOVING_TEXT` lookup table) -- no interpolation of any dynamic marker field (e.g. prNumber, reason) into the message/command text, by design, since the AC requires a FIXED string per condition. `buildStatusReport` (src/commands/status.ts) now attaches this as `report.diagnostic` (optional at the type level for construction ergonomics, but always set before either return path) by calling `diagnoseWhyNotMoving(report, readWhyNotMovingSignals(cwd))` right before each of buildStatusReport's two return statements (the idle-early-return branch and the final branch), so report.state (incl. the operator-paused override) is always final first. The orch-pane-busy / push-undelivered(reason) signals are NOT new StatusReport fields -- they are read straight from the event log by a new `readWhyNotMovingSignals` helper in status.ts, built on a new generic `scanLastEventOfKind<T>(cwd, kind, guard)` scanner that the pre-existing `readLastContainerPreflightEvent` (US-002) was ALSO refactored onto (net LOC roughly flat despite the two new readers -- see patterns.md bullet). `cam status`'s print path (runStatus) was NOT wired to render `report.diagnostic` -- out of scope for this story's AC, which only covered buildStatusReport attaching the model; printing it is a natural follow-up. src/commands/status.ts's file-size-budget.json ceiling was raised 850->913.
